calls.head: There’s no curse: Luukkonen against the Maple Leafs
calls.body: Luukkonen has been shaky against the Maple Leafs since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

story.head: Gilbert sparks a Sabres comeback
paras: Kirill Marchenko had a hat trick for the Maple Leafs. Jack Quinn had a Gordie Howe hat trick: a goal, an assist and a fight. Auston Matthews struck first for the Maple Leafs early in the first. Quinn made it 1-1, 1:11 later. Marchenko gave the Leafs the lead on the power play midway through the first. Quinn struck again early in the second to tie it 2-2. The Maple Leafs’ Gavin McKenna didn’t play after 10:20 of the second period. Marchenko scored again midway through the second to put the Maple Leafs ahead 3-2. Marchenko completed his hat trick late in the second to make it 4-2. The Maple Leafs’ John Tavares left early in the third period and didn’t return. Dennis Gilbert and Mattias Samuelsson scored 2:11 apart midway through the third to tie it 4-4. Owen Power won it in overtime. Quinn also had two assists.
The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 26 saves for the Sabres, and Sergei Bobrovsky allowed five goals on 34 shots.
Quinn and Troy Stecher dropped the gloves late in the second. The Sabres improved to 4-3-1, and the Maple Leafs fell to 3-3-2.
